# Diaz Tech Home Page
> Diaz Technologies Inc. is a company focused on selling post-consumer resin, promoting recycling, and supporting the circular economy. They partner with suppliers and engage in initiatives to reuse and repurpose materials effectively. The site also details their commitment to web accessibility, outlining adjustments made to comply with WCAG 2.2 guidelines. Additionally, Diaz Technologies Inc. provides information on their services, team, and a general overview of privacy policies, emphasizing the importance of legal counsel for specific policy creation.

## Homepage link
- [home](https://www.diaztech.net/)
